PR #44551 is now merged, but the issue also mentions Color Picker and FancyZones Editor and does not establish which processes remain affected on a current build. Could you confirm current PowerToys version/architecture and list only the process names and approximate idle memory that still look abnormal? No profiling or new logs are needed.
